# Aiven

Skills that teach agents to work with Aiven. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [aiven/aiven-ai-plugins](https://github.com/aiven/aiven-ai-plugins), at commit `634f41d`.

Easily deploy managed PostgreSQL (pg), Kafka, OpenSearch, Clickhouse and other databases, streaming and apps.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Aiven**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Aiven**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install aiven@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `aiven-getting-started`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/aiven/aiven-ai-plugins
